# CANCELLATION OF SYSTEM ALERT (Cold) – NFGDC NEW YORK


#### February 10, 2026


Please be advised that the Cold Weather System Alert, which began on Friday, January 16th, 2026, is being cancelled effective Wednesday, February 11th, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. EST. If you have any questions, please contact the Help Desk at 716-857-7232.
